review_notes: The mined bundle was a sixteen-item lookup with a prose deliverable and GLM-5.2 passed it 5 of 5. Removing the shortcuts left it at 5 of 5 and made it faster (15m54s to 9m39s), so nothing had depended on them. Adding four independent conditionals left it at 5 of 5 with runtime tripled: independent obligations do not compound. Rebuilding as a dependency chain gave 0 of 4, but the detail showed every run passing all 105 graded cells and failing one undefined figure, so that was ambiguity not difficulty. Defining the figures gave 4 of 4, which settled that the chain alone is worth nothing against this model. Making the audit a comparison between an asserted position and the position the governing holding gives gave 0 of 4, and again the detail showed a defect: half the items stated conduct rather than what the register requires, and conduct cannot be compared with a holding.
